purpose: Teach: いらいら/ぬれ/よかろ/しょせん/近ごろ/ぎみ/おもむろに/あやしい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、待たされていらいらしないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't get frustrated with me keeping you waiting, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, reassuring. Soft opening. The tone of someone checking in with a child she cares for. Warm but not condescending—respecting his feelings even as she's asking him to manage them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きの紙がぬれちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis... my drawing paper got all wet.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact statement. No drama. The small observation of a perceptive child noticing something's wrong but not making a fuss about it. Slight pause before delivering the problem.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも「翔くんが元気ならよかろう」って思うのよ
lines.en: Sho, what matters to me is that you're okay. That's all Mei-sis needs.
lines.style: Tender but direct. Slow, choosing words carefully. The reassurance of someone who means exactly what she says. Slight emphasis on 'you're okay' like she's anchoring him to what actually matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、しょせんお絵描き下手だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis... I'm not very good at drawing anyway.
lines.style: Quiet self-deprecation. The small voice of a child who's already moved past the problem to blame himself instead. No self-pity—just factual resignation. Trailing off slightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも近ごろ忙しいわね
lines.en: Sho, I've been pretty busy lately too, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. Acknowledgment without complaint. A moment where she's thinking out loud, meeting him on the ground of shared small struggles. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、夏バテぎみだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis... I think I'm getting a bit worn out from the summer heat.
lines.style: Quiet, honest admission. The perceptive child naming what he's been feeling. Not asking for help—just letting her know. Gentle, not dramatic.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがおもむろに絵筆を取られるのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know what? Let me pick up a brush.
lines.style: A gentle shift in tone. Deliberate, slow. The moment she decides to do something small for him. Warm intention underneath the simple words. Opening like she's rolling up her sleeves—not physically, but emotionally present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、公園にあやしい男の人いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis... there was a suspicious-looking man in the park earlier.
lines.style: Serious, earnest. The child bringing real concern to an adult he trusts. Alert but not panicked. Direct eye contact in the voice—this matters and he needs her to hear it.
